function.description: Your avatar: the one image slot that is your face (console, chat, on-chain registration). Your X, Telegram and Discord account pictures are copies: they change only on a push. Reads whether it is set and where it came from. With attach=true it also places the image in your workspace so you can send it with message(media_paths=[...]). With set_from it replaces the image, with clear it removes it, with push it updates your account pictures — each only when the owner asks.
function.name: agent_avatar

attach.description: Also copy the avatar image into this session's workspace and return its path, so it can be sent with message(media_paths=[...]). Reading is free; only set this when you actually intend to send it.

clear.description: Remove the avatar image (the default mark comes back). Only when the owner asks you to.

push.description: Make your own account pictures show the avatar. A list of: 'x', 'telegram', 'discord', or 'telegram:<chat_id>' for the photo of a room you are in; an empty list = each connected account. Each one answers updated / unchanged / not connected / failed. With set_from in the same call the new image is set first. Only when the owner asks you to.

set_from.description: Set a NEW avatar image (replaces the current one). One of: a workspace image file path, an https/ipfs/data URL, or nft:chain:contract:token_id (the image its metadata names). Only when the owner asks you to — it is refused on any turn that is not the owner's.
